notes.title: Nine Dots Backstage is coming back on October 2nd
notes.notes:
[p]Tune in this [b]October 2nd at 2PM Eastern Time[/b] on Twitch for the third exciting edition of our Backstage Livestream. Guillaume Boucher-Vidal, our CEO and Creative Director, will be with us once again to answer your questions about Outward 2 and show you the character creator- no more potato head for you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="U5nDFXXyRuY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][p]Don’t forget to mark your calendars for the Outward 2 reveal during the [b]Tokyo Game Show[/b] on September 28th at 12pm EST / / PM CET / 9 AM PT. We will be live on [url="https://www.twitch.tv/ninedotsstudio"][u]Twitch[/u][/url] to watch the show live with you![/p][p]
[/p][p]‘Real, Raw and Honest’ is our Backstage Livestream’s motto and this is what you will get. Remember: Some stuff that will be shown during the livestream may still be in development.[/p][p]That’s part of the fun, sharing our process with you guys. We hope you will take part and come chat with us.
[/p][p]Bianca[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: New trailer coming on September 28th
notes.notes: [p]We’re [b]very[/b] happy to reveal our new Artwork and screenshots for Outward 2. [/p][p]You can find the video reveal [url="https://youtu.be/P0jb7s4tz6g"]here.[/url][/p][p]The Steam store page just got a makeover. Head over to the Outward 2 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2849490/Outward_2/"]Steam page[/url][i] to see the page's fresh look [/i]and show your support by adding the game to your wishlist.[/p][p][/p][p]Outward 2 will be part of the PC Gaming show during the Tokyo Game Show on September 28th, 12PM EST. Tune in to discover the new Outward 2 trailer during the event or watch it with us live on our Twitch channel. [/p][p][/p][p]We are now opening registrations for our upcoming playtest. [/p][p]You can find him on [url="https://www.instagram.com/tomas.duchek/"]Instagram[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Bianca[/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Discover how we create a skill tree on May 22nd and more ...
notes.notes:
Tune in on Twitch on May 22nd for our 2nd Nine Dots Backstage where we open the curtains on what’s happening at Nine Dots Studio.

In this livestream Guillaume Boucher-Vidal, Outward’s creative director and Nine Dots Studio’s CEO, will tell you more about his creative process when creating skill trees.

We’ll also share behind the scene content for Outward 2.

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/ninedotsstudio]Follow us on Twitch[/url] to get notified 

In case you missed the [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/uIJPOiS7V3E]first edition of the backstage.[/url]

Learn more about the backstage content [url=https://ninedotsstudio.com/blog/nine-dots-backstage-2-may-22nd/]here.[/url]

[b]Mandatory disclaimer [/b]
[i]What you will see might not make it into the final game [/i]

Matthieu

notes.title: Tune in for our first Livestream on Outward 2 on October 16th on Twitch
notes.notes:
Join us on October 16th at 2PM Eastern Time on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ninedotsstudio]Twitch [/url]for Nine Dots Backstage Livestream.

Hosted by Guillaume Boucher-Vidal, our CEO and Creative Director, we will show two regions from Outward 2 and give you more details about how we’re creating Outward 2. 


Keep in mind that what you will see might not make it into the final game, but for now, you’ll get an exclusive look. 


Read all info and get a screen Wallpaper for Outward 2 featuring the beautiful region of the Gilded Mountains[url=https://ninedotsstudio.com/blog/backstagelivestream1610/]on our website[/url].

notes.title: Discover Pre-Alpha combat gameplay from our demo with 5 great content creators.
notes.notes:

We wanted to show our promise of a [b]smoother combat system [/b]with our PAX demo but it was too rough to share with everyone so we reached out to a [b]few outstanding Outward content creators[/b] to look it up and share their thoughts. 

So have a look and let us know what you think!
